title: Dimasik Pack
description: Armor, tools, bows, and elytra have been redesigned for clearer visuals and smoother PvP. Crafted so key elements stand out in combat while keeping a clean, cohesive style.
body: A PvP-focused resource pack for servers, fully optimized for combat. Textures for armor and tools (iron, gold, diamond, netherite) as well as bows and elytra have been updated for a sharper, more modern look. Many items and blocks have been reworked for improved visual clarity and aesthetics, making gameplay smoother and more dynamic. Every element is designed with PvP in mind, ensuring key objects stand out without distracting from the fight, and all textures maintain a clean, cohesive style.
